card.name: Small linking words before a condition
card.fires_on: Short linking words (in, with, for, of an) that come right after patients, risk, or a treatment and just before a disease or patient group name, such as myeloma, ovarian cancer, or pediatric patients.

modes.label: with after patients
modes.description: The word with after patient(s), leading into a named disease.
modes.example: in a study of patients<< with>> myeloma, final analysis after

modes.label: for/of after risk
modes.description: A linking word after the word risk, before the condition at risk.
modes.example: had an increased risk<< for>> ovarian cancer.

modes.label: in after a treatment or indication
modes.description: The word in after a treated condition, before the population.
modes.example: Treatment of VTE<< in>> pediatric patients (see Table 5 )
